questions.question: What distinguishes the direction or magnitude of change between hardware-style product lines and Services?

answer.value: In the 2022–2023 window (as encoded on Year vs Revenue_Billions), hardware-style series sit at far larger absolute revenue than Services: MacBook is the top line (~1720→1750 B), iPhone next (~895→915 B), then Watch (~410→420 B), AirPods (~185→189 B), and Other_Products (~91→94 B). Services is a much thinner line (~23.1→25.0 B) but still ticks up year over year. Direction: all listed series move up slightly 2022→2023; magnitude of change is dominated by MacBook and iPhone in absolute billions, while Services shows a small absolute step on a small base. (Legend/encoding names: MacBook, iPhone, Watch, AirPods, Services, Other_Products.)

key_insights: Hardware product lines occupy the top of the y-scale; Services remains near the bottom of the multi-series chart in this window.
Every visible product series rises from 2022 to 2023; largest dollar increments are on the highest-revenue lines.
